priorityList.notes: Cold Blood right before the finisher for a guaranteed crit -- the Assassination burst button, since the spec has no Adrenaline Rush. Does not spend combo points, so it is safe to check ahead of the finishers below regardless of which one ends up spending them.

Venom as an alternate finisher the Forever Assassination tree grants: named per the brief's rule for a talent-added ability the engine cannot cast yet (no dedicated sim/rogue implementation), so this line will warn and skip until it is implemented, and Eviscerate below is what actually spends the combo points today.

Eviscerate at five combo points: the functional finisher while Venom is not yet implemented. Checked ahead of Slice and Dice's refresh so a full five-point finisher is never given up in favor of a refresh. Was starved entirely: Slice and Dice used to sit ahead of this line instead, re-applying itself at currentComboPoints >= 1 with no floor, so it looped at 1-3 combo points forever and this line never saw five.

Slice and Dice: only ever spend combo points on it once there are five banked, and only when it actually needs it -- down entirely, or under 3s remaining. Kept at the same five-combo-point floor as Eviscerate above so combo points are never spent below five on either finisher; Eviscerate above claims the combo points whenever both are ready in the same instant.

Mutilate as the Forever Assassination talent's intended combo-point builder: named per the brief's rule for a talent-added ability the engine cannot cast yet (no dedicated sim/rogue implementation), so this line will warn and skip until it is implemented, and Sinister Strike below is what actually builds combo points today.
Sinister Strike as the combo point builder while Mutilate is not yet implemented.
